How to play

  1. One fight. Knock the other fighter's health bar down to 0. You take turns: one card per turn.
  2. Tap a card, then tap a fighter: tap the opponent for Attack cards, tap yourself for Heal, Guard and Charge. The fighter you can tap glows.
  3. Attack deals damage. Heal restores health. Guard puts a shield on you that soaks up the next hit. Charge gives +1 spirit plus a small bonus.
  4. Your deck has 15 cards, your hand 5. Playing a card does not draw a new one: the card goes back into your deck. After your 5th card you gather spirit: 5 new cards and +1 spirit.
  5. At the start you may swap up to 2 cards. The fighter who moves second starts with Guard 3.
  6. Spirit meter (4 pips): when it is full your signature button lights up. Fox Fire Fist / Light of Blade deals 15, ignores Guard, and empties the meter.
  7. Long fight? After 14 turns each, Fury: every attack deals +1, and +1 more every 2 turns.
  8. Card colour = rarity: gray Common, green Uncommon, blue Rare, purple Epic, orange Legendary. The small RYO / AOI badge shows whose card it is.
  9. Moves play out on the board: tap the board to fast-forward. Signature moves get a full-screen cut-in: tap it to skip.
